Shortly after the [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|onset]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in [[3681 BBY]], an '''insurrection''' occurred within the Empire, spurred on by the designs of the ambitious [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Vich]]. The insurrection was a domestic Imperial conflict that began when Vich led his newly acquired [[Darth Vich's army|army]] of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]] and [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] against the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]]. Vich was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the attempt and his [[Army/Legends|army]] was destroyed, with many of the Rattataki being executed or [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]. The defeat allowed the Dark Council to continue its rule of the Empire and its war against the Republic.

==Prelude==
The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] was a totalitarian and [[Speciesism|xenophobic]] regime ruled by the reclusive [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and run by the twelve [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords]] of the executive [[Dark Council]]. In [[3681 BBY]], the Empire's rulers led their massive [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military force]] and legions of inferior [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] into a war against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that would last for twenty-eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. This [[Great Galactic War]] [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|began]] in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and saw many early victories for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], in spite of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] reluctance to form alliances and the general Imperial proclivity to only trust [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and their [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblooded Sith]] contemporaries.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Despite the early success, the Empire faced a threat from within in the form of the young and ambitious Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]], [[Darth Vich]]. Around 3,681 BBY, Vich took note of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in the [[Trilon sector/Legends|Trilon sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> A new addition to the [[galactic community]], the world's fierce and hardy [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] people had only recently begun to leave the perpetual wars of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to seek violent glory elsewhere. Vich, intending to seize power from the Dark Council, saw the Rattataki as his opportunity to topple the standing Imperial regime.<ref name="Holonet">{{HolonetOld|inhabitants|rattataki|Rattataki}}</ref>

==The insurrection==
[[File:KaliyoDjannis-TOR.png|thumb|left|200px|A Rattataki]]
Disregarding a millennium of xenophobic Imperial tradition, the young Vich traveled to Rattatak and recruited hundreds of tribes of the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] into his [[Darth Vich's army|personal army]] by promising them glory in battle against the Republic in the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Vich led them away from their world and identified dozens of them as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]; while most of the aliens became dangerous and impressive [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] for his cause, Vich [[Sith training|trained]] the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-talented few in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] as [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]]. Although his resources and ambition were both formidable, Vich's attempt at ascendency was quashed by the Dark Council.<ref name="Holonet" /> Forces under the control of the Dark Lords [[Death/Legends|killed]] Vich during the insurrection, and the deceased Sith Lord's [[Army/Legends|army]] was swiftly disbanded.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Rumor later held that it was Vich's own Rattataki acolytes who betrayed him to the Dark Council, thus ensuring his downfall.<ref name="Holonet" />

==Aftermath==
Following the insurrection, the Dark Council sentenced many of the Rattataki warriors to death and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] the others. The Council again turned its focus to the Great Galactic War, but the insurrection had nevertheless managed to attract the Empire's attention&mdash;the strongest of the enslaved Rattataki were soon taken out of the slave labor pools and thrust into lessons at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to complete the training that [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vich had begun. Others resisted the Empire's presence on their homeworld, either by fleeing Rattatak and joining fringe enterprises or by remaining on the planet to fight the occupiers and gain battle glory.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

The Great Galactic War dragged on for nearly three more [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] and ultimately culminated in a Sith victory.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that immediately followed the Great War, word of Vich's surviving Rattataki Sith acolytes persisted only as rumor.<ref name="Holonet" /> Although the Dark Council would continue to face infrequent challenges from upstart Sith Lords like Darth Vich, these secessionists, revolutionaries, and usurpers like Lord [[Tytonus]]<ref name="Friends of Old">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|Friends of Old|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> and Darths [[Darth Ikoral|Ikoral]]<ref name="Red Reaper">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Red Reaper}}</ref> and [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]] were all foiled and killed, allowing the Council to continue its rule.<ref name="False Emperor">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|False Emperor}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Vich's insurrection was introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] as background lore for the online role-playing [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The event was first mentioned in the Rattataki entry on [[The Holonet]], an online databank containing information about characters and events in ''The Old Republic''. The entry was first posted in [[2011]] but was deprecated along with several others after the website's update prior to the game's [[December]] release later that year.<ref name="Holonet" />
